description: Arkansas felony SENTENCING STANDARDS GRID: the presumptive sentence range for a seriousness level (1-10) and criminal history score (0-5+), from the Arkansas Sentencing Commission. Answers "presumptive sentence range at seriousness level 10, criminal history category III", "Arkansas sentencing grid level 7 score 2", "how many months for a level 6 felony with 4 prior points". With criminal_history_score returns that cell: the presumptive prison (ADC) range in months and years when the grid presumes one, the sanction types the cell allows (ADC = Department of Correction facility, CCC = Community Correction Center, AS = alternative sanctions), the grid edition and effective date (offenses committed on or after 2018-01-01), release/transfer eligibility notes, the statutory range by felony class, and offenses the Commission lists at that level. Without a score returns all six cells of the level. This is the Commission's presumptive grid, not the habitual-offender statute (5-4-501) and not a prediction of the sentence a court will impose. Use ar_offense_seriousness to find an offense's level. Keyless.

criminal_history_score.description: Criminal history score 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 or "5+" (category III = score 3). Omit for all six.
